name: COME HOME
source:
Historical restoration is a difficult job. Lots of paperwork is involved, not to mention all the physical labour required to transform a dilapidated shack to its former glory.

You are stuck with babysitting a house in-between these phases. Alone. For three days.

That's not strictly true, actually. You have one job, and that's to jumpstart the cataloguing and cleaning process of the house whilst the proper restoration team is stuck in the straits. You have only your wits at your disposal, as well as an irritable groundskeeper to skirt around your questions.

What will your exploration of the house grant you?

[From [url=https://clerichsxi.itch.io/come-home]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
历史建筑修复是一项艰难的工作。不仅需要处理大量文书，要让破败的小屋恢复昔日荣光，更少不了繁重的体力劳动。

在这些工序之间，你得留下来照看房子。独自一人。整整三天。

其实，这话也不完全准确。你有一项任务：在正式修复团队暂时无法到场的期间，先行开始整理登记与清洁工作。你只能依靠自己的头脑，外加一个脾气暴躁、总对你的问题顾左右而言他的园丁。

这场宅邸探索，会为你带来什么？

[摘自[url=https://clerichsxi.itch.io/come-home]itch.io[/url]]
